about: Every Plan board-anno kind (src/types.ts · BoardKind) with the workspace schemaVersion that
introduced it. The server never lets a save stamped below a stored object's version delete that
object (app/workspace_kinds.py). A new kind gets a row here AND bumps WORKSPACE_SCHEMA_VERSION
(src/lib/workspace.ts) to its version: src/lib/boardKinds.test.ts fails on a kind missing here,
a row the client does not know, or a version the client has not reached.
Kinds older than the stamp read 1 (a blob without schemaVersion).
